37.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(value_yoy) END AS "Merchandise change · vs same month last year" 
FROM (SELECT m.release_id,m.month,m.month::text AS purchase_month,
                  (m.delivered_merchandise_value-p.delivered_merchandise_value)/nullif(p.delivered_merchandise_value,0) AS value_mom,
                  (m.delivered_merchandise_value-y.delivered_merchandise_value)/nullif(y.delivered_merchandise_value,0) AS value_yoy
                  FROM reporting.validated_sales_monthly m LEFT JOIN reporting.validated_sales_monthly p ON p.release_id=m.release_id AND p.month=m.month-interval '1 month'
                  LEFT JOIN reporting.validated_sales_monthly y ON y.release_id=m.release_id AND y.month=m.month-interval '1 year'
                  WHERE m.release_id='87f01740-0523-5fd4-be0e-eb52acb2842a'
) AS virtual_table 
WHERE purchase_month IN ('2018-07-01') 
 LIMIT 1000;

35.query:
SELECT category AS category, SUM(delivered_merchandise_value) AS "Category contribution · top 5 + others" 
FROM (WITH ranked AS (
                  SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY month ORDER BY delivered_merchandise_value DESC,category) AS rank
                  FROM reporting.validated_product_monthly WHERE release_id='87f01740-0523-5fd4-be0e-eb52acb2842a')
                  SELECT release_id,month,month::text AS purchase_month,CASE WHEN rank<=5 THEN category ELSE 'Other categories' END AS category,
                  sum(delivered_merchandise_value) AS delivered_merchandise_value
                  FROM ranked GROUP BY release_id,month,CASE WHEN rank<=5 THEN category ELSE 'Other categories' END
) AS virtual_table 
WHERE purchase_month IN ('2018-07-01') GROUP BY category ORDER BY "Category contribution · top 5 + others" DESC 
 LIMIT 6;
